desc:
Welcome to an immersive MMORPG inspired by the anime Sword Art Online.

CHOOSE YOUR IMMERSION!
This game offers a unique First Person perspective alongside Third Person, and a Permanent Death game mode for those hardcore fans!

Your primary goal is to reach the top of the floor dungeon where a fearsome foe awaits you, however there is a twist; You can suffer a death penalty upon death. Will you play it safe? Or will you risk everything for greater rewards? 
---
Platforms: PC, Console, Mobile, Tablet
---
